about: Published vulnerabilities in what a deployment installs that are NOT fixed yet, each with why it cannot reach a user of this app and a date to look again. scripts/qa/dependencies.mjs fails on an entry past its date, and on an entry for something no longer reported. Emptied 2026-10-23: next 15.5.27 -> 15.5.28 fixed a critical advisory (an RCE in image optimisation with SVG, and a server-action DoS), and postcss and deepmerge-ts are pinned to their fixed releases beneath Next and Prisma's config loader (package.json `overrides`), which cleared the four entries accepted on 2026-10-13 (postcss, deepmerge-ts, @prisma/config, prisma). Not empty since 2026-11-17: picomatch GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf has no patched release and reaches the install only beneath @sentry/nextjs's unused webpack loader, so it and the four packages it makes high are accepted until 2026-12-01, by the owner's explicit permission, on the Security Lead's assessment that no request reaches it. While they stand, nobody wraps next.config in withSentryConfig. On 2026-12-01 pin the patched release if there is one, otherwise replace @sentry/nextjs with @sentry/node; do not renew.

accepted.reason: GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf (slow regular expression from a crafted glob pattern); no patched release exists (latest is 4.0.7). In what ships it is installed only beneath @sentry/nextjs's webpack loader (config/loaders/wrappingLoader.js), which runs only when next.config is wrapped in withSentryConfig. This app does not wrap it: Sentry is used only in src/instrumentation.ts (init, captureRequestError). No request reaches picomatch and no person's text becomes a pattern. On 1 Dec: pin the patched release if there is one, otherwise replace @sentry/nextjs with @sentry/node.
